name: Virgin Hotels Nashville
insider_take: Music City's rebel with a cause - where rock 'n' roll hospitality meets Nashville's legendary soul.
whats_special: Virgin Hotels Nashville occupies the historic Life & Casualty Tower, a 1957 Art Deco landmark that once housed Tennessee's first skyscraper insurance company. The rooftop Commons Club offers panoramic views of the Cumberland River and downtown skyline, while the lobby's original terrazzo floors tell stories of Nashville's golden era.
pro_tip: Book a corner room on floors 15+ for unobstructed views of the Ryman Auditorium and Broadway's neon glow - especially stunning during CMA Fest when the entire district lights up.
dont_miss: The hotel sits just two blocks from the legendary Tootsies Orchid Lounge, where Hank Williams and Patsy Cline once performed. Take the secret underground tunnel system that connects several Broadway honky-tonks - originally built during Prohibition and still used by musicians today.
pros: Prime downtown location in Music Row district
Modern Virgin brand design with innovative room layouts
Multiple dining venues including rooftop bar and grill
State-of-the-art fitness center and wellness amenities
cons: Contemporary lifestyle hotel may not suit traditional preferences
Downtown location means urban noise levels
